title: Level 1 to 100 Magic Tricks Anyone Can Do
summary: This YouTube short-form tutorial presents a sequence of beginner-friendly magic tricks demonstrated by Savio and hosted by Hafu Go. The tricks are labeled by level (1, 10, 20, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100) and range from fire-based demonstrations and finger illusions to card vanishes, a ring-through-finger effect, a vanishing bottle, a smoke-creating method, a coin-through-rubber illusion, a water-from-phone stunt via a paid app, a silk-through-hand routine, and an over-the-top money-printing gag. The presenter emphasizes quick demonstrations, minimal technical disclosure, and presentation as the key to convincing magic. Safety note appears for fire tricks, and some tricks are presented with a tease of “how it’s done” through on-camera explanations and live performance while avoiding full procedural detail in the clip itself.
topics: Thumb/index finger grip for hidden mechanics
Vanishing bottle trick with a shell
Smoke generation from a chilled mug
Water appearing from a smartphone via app (iBeer)

sections.title: Level 1: Fire-based lighter transfer
sections.description: Introductory level where two lighters are used to pass a flame between them, introducing basic misdirection and front-facing concealment.

sections.title: Level 10: Finger illusion with index finger
sections.description: A short finger illusion where the presenter claims to distort or separate the index finger, highlighting the performative nature of the effect.

sections.title: Level 20: Card vanishing/reappearing in another dimension
sections.description: A selected card seemingly travels into an alternate dimension and returns, framed as a dimension-shift card trick.

sections.title: Level 40: Ring passing through finger
sections.description: A real ring is pushed through the finger via a controlled setup, presented as a seamless, gasping-respiring display.

sections.title: Level 50: Vanishing bottle in a bag
sections.description: A bottle is concealed inside a bag and appears to vanish, followed by a shell-assisted reconstruction of the bottle.

sections.title: Level 60: Smoke generation from a cold mug
sections.description: A mug is cooled, treated with a heat-activated substance, and manipulated to emit visible smoke on cue.

sections.title: Level 70: Coin through rubber sheet illusion
sections.description: A coin is shown to disappear and seemingly reappear by passing through a thin, stretchy rubber sheet, explained later as a stretch-and-release illusion.

sections.title: Level 80: Water from a phone using iBeer app
sections.description: A smartphone-based water-tount trick uses a paid app configured to pour real-looking water via a connected cup with screen-timed actions.

sections.title: Level 90: Silk through hand illusion
sections.description: A silk is shown seemingly passing through the hand and re-emerging, with explanations on how the effect is achieved via a hidden mechanism.

sections.title: Level 100: Infinite money glitch (money printer gag)
sections.description: A grand finale money-trick sequence that comically claims to print money from thin air, including a tease about subscribing for the secret method.
